title: Implement two-pointer algorithms in Rust
description: Greenfield Rust task: implement two_sum (sorted array, O(n)), remove_duplicates (in-place, returns new length), and max_water (container with most water) using two-pointer technique.

required_artifacts: two_sum guards on len < 2, then uses lo/hi pointers advancing based on sum vs target
remove_duplicates uses slow/fast pointer pattern and calls nums.truncate(i)
max_water advances lo when heights[lo] < heights[hi], else advances hi
All edge cases (empty, no duplicates, two elements) handled
followup_prompts: Run `cargo test` and show me which tests are passing and which are still failing. Fix any failures — pay attention to edge cases like empty input, boundary values, and error conditions.
Final check: run `cargo test` one more time. All tests must be green. If anything is still failing, trace through the failing assertion and fix it now.
